t: A very low-power Ambiq chip built to run small AI models in wearables.
steps: Buy the Ambiq AP510EVB evaluation board from a distributor such as DigiKey or Future Electronics.
Get a USB-C data cable and plug the board into your computer.
Install the Zephyr tools and the west command by following the Zephyr getting started guide.
Install the SEGGER J-Link software for flashing through the onboard probe.
Build the Zephyr blinky sample for the apollo510_evb target and flash it.
Try the neuralSPOT examples next to run a small AI model.
Add the audio or display add-on board for sound and screen projects.
meta: Open Code. From $262. A few stores.
